about: The probe script for the device gate (Task 34; the C5 probe runs under it): a made-up waiting code whose beats wait and whose Go live is refused, so nothing reaches staging. Copy the file whole, as files/scripted-code.json, into a debug build's private storage with adb shell run-as; the scripted server reads only code, beat and start, so this note travels harmlessly. A route's answers go in order and the last repeats; {"fail": true} is no answer at all. Every value is made up: no token, no credential. serverBodies.test.ts checks each body against the web's contracts, and ScriptAnswersTest answers this file at the descriptor's own URLs.
